Cancellations policy
Before the order ships
## [CAN-1] Before the order ships Any order can be cancelled free of charge until it is shipped, by the customer from My Orders in the app. The support assistant cannot cancel orders itself; it guides the customer to My Orders. The refund is initiated immediately.

Cancellations policy
After the order ships
## [CAN-2] After the order ships A shipped order cannot be cancelled. The customer can: - refuse the parcel at the door. For cash-on-delivery orders nothing is charged. For prepaid orders the refund follows REF-1 once the parcel returns to the warehouse; or - accept the delivery and return the item within its return window, if the category is returnable.

Cancellations policy
Partial cancellation
## [CAN-4] Partial cancellation Individual items in a multi-item order can be cancelled before they ship. Coupon rules in REF-4 apply.

Cancellations policy
Grocery delivery slots
## [CAN-3] Grocery delivery slots Grocery orders can be cancelled up to 2 hours before the start of the chosen delivery slot. If the slot start time is not in the order record, ask the customer for the time shown in My Orders before confirming whether the cutoff has passed.

About this knowledge base
Business days
## [KB-00.3] Business days A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days. | Date | Holiday | | --- | --- | | 2026-08-15 | Independence Day | | 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti | | 2026-10-19 | Warehouse closure (festival) | | 2026-11-09 | Warehouse closure (festival) |

Verifying the customer
How to verify
## [IDV-2] How to verify Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.
